verses.16: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.
verses.17: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
verses.18: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
verses.19: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
verses.20: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
verses.21: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
verses.22: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.
